title: 初二长对话：钥匙与风筝线
source_notice: 初二普通期末公开卷具体结构已核；主卷三节5/5/5与参考键合写后10题标题冲突保留。正文地域未知、学校原版未认证；首5脚本完整而后段截断，原录音缺，不当gold。本稿为完整原创配套，未通过独立教研/学生/商用或生产验证。
timing_notice: 每段两遍，听前听后每题5秒；间隔和重播提示为本机编排
instruction: 听两段长对话，第一段回答第1—2题，第二段回答第3—5题，从A、B、C中选最佳答案。每段两遍，听前、听后按每题5秒留时。

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Good evening. I am staying in Room Twenty-One, but my key does not work.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I am sorry. Let me check it at the desk. Is your name Mrs Green?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Yes. I have tried the key twice.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: The card is damaged. I will give you a new one. Please return the old card to me now.

questions.stem: Where does the conversation probably happen?
questions.rationale: A：住宿房号和钥匙卡不支持学校；B：房间入住、前台换卡支持酒店；C：无园艺用品

options: Give the woman another key card.
Move her to a different room.
Ask her to pay for another night.
questions.rationale: A：明确give you a new one；B：房间未改；C：无额外付费

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Why are you putting the kite away, Sara? The wind is still strong.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: The string broke twice yesterday. I need a stronger one before I fly it again.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: There is a shop by the bridge. I bought some string there last month.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Yes, until four. It is only half past two now. We can walk there.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Good. I will take the kite with me, so the shopkeeper can see what I need.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I will come too. I need some glue for my model boat.

questions.stem: Why does Sara need new string?
questions.rationale: A：没有送人；B：风仍强；C：明确断过两次
A：明确by the bridge；B：无学校方位；C：无影院方位

questions.stem: Why will Sara take her kite to the shop?
questions.rationale: A：未出售；B：让店主看需要什么线；C：未提比赛
